sentences.text: This is a petition filed seeking quashing of the FIR No. 0802/2016 dated 06.08.2016 registered at PS Aman Vihar under Section 498A/406/506/34 IPC and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

The parties have arrived at a settlement dated 26.02.2020 before the learned Family Court,
North-West, Rohini Courts, Delhi, pursuant to which the petitioners had to pay a sum of Rs. 4.9 lakhs to the respondent No.2.

entities.text:
Family Court,
North-West, Rohini Courts, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
A sum of Rs. 3.2 has already been paid by the petitioners to respondent No.2 and the balance sum of Rs. 1.7 lakh is being paid today in Court vide DD No.
808741 dated 12.01.2023 drawn on Federal Bank.
The petitioners are present in Court and have been identified by Mr. Siddharth Singh, learned counsel.
The respondent No.2 is also present in Court and has been identified by SI Gurdeep Singh PS Aman Vihar and Mr. Dev Karan, learned counsel.
The parties state that they have arrived at the aforesaid settlement out of their own free will and without any undue influence, threat, pressure or coercion.
The respondent No.2 states that she has no objection if the present FIR is quashed.
There is one minor daughter named Arna who is in the care and custody of the respondent No.2.

sentences.text: 1 is directed that the settlement and this order shall not come in the way of the minor daughter claiming her rights of inheritance, maintenance, education, marriage etc. against any of the parties.

In view of the aforesaid, the FIR No. 0802/2016 dated 06.08.2016 registered at PS Aman Vihar under Section 498A/406/506/34 IPC and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom are hereby quashed.
